entities.name: Fortress Badlands
entities.description: A desolate expanse of reddish sandstone hillocks in Orrithia, near Strixhaven University, blighted and used as a haven by Murgaxor Grenshel's followers.

entities.name: Murgaxor Grenshel
entities.description: A renegade mage whose followers and thralls fortified the badlands.

entities.name: Y'demi
entities.description: A blood mage occupying Murgaxor's former chambers.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: University about twenty miles from the badlands.

entities.name: Lorehold
entities.description: Strixhaven college whose teams conduct fieldwork in the badlands.

entities.name: Ruins of Caerdoon
entities.description: Ruins toward which Murgaxor moved, site of life-draining rituals.

events.summary: Murgaxor Grenshel's followers and thralls make the badlands a fortified haven.
events.quote: the badlands have become a haven for followers and thralls of the renegade mage Murgaxor Grenshel

events.summary: The blood mage Y'demi occupies Murgaxor's former chambers.
events.quote: Murgaxor's former personal chambers, now occupied by the blood mage Y'demi
